name: Metaphorical Bridge
axiom: Map the unfamiliar onto something the audience already operates.
trigger: Explaining a technical mechanism whose structure the audience already knows from somewhere else.

steps.text: Name the target concept and its hard part.
Choose a source domain with the same structure.
Map each part explicitly, and name where the mapping breaks.

antiPattern.violation: A metaphor carried past the structure it shares, so the audience reasons correctly inside it and wrongly outside.
antiPattern.remediation: State the boundary. 'It is like X, except Y' keeps the model useful past the diagram.
